title: validate action
description: Validates a JSON body against a JSON Schema; an invalid message fails with every problem found. Set schema or schemaFile.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The JSON Schema, inline. Supports type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, minLength, maxLength, pattern, minItems and maxItems

schemaFile.title: Schema file
schemaFile.description: Path of a file holding the JSON Schema, read when the flow is loaded
